remote_sub: Send a URL, search for a torrent, or ask for a trailer from a paired phone.
remote_telegram_desc: Paste the token from @BotFather here, then pair your phone with a 6-digit code.
remote_lan_desc: Local network only — never reachable from the internet. Pair via QR or manual PIN.
remote_guide_title: How to create the Telegram bot
remote_guide_step1: Open Telegram, search for @BotFather and start a chat.
remote_guide_step2: Send /newbot, pick a display name and a unique username ending in "bot" (e.g. my_flux_bot).
remote_guide_step3: BotFather replies with a token (a string like 123456789:AAExample-Token) — copy it.
remote_guide_step4: Paste it in the field above and press "Save".
remote_guide_step5: Press "Generate pairing code", then open a chat with your bot on your phone and send the 6-digit code as your first message.
remote_guide_step6: Done — from that chat you can send a URL, search for a torrent, or write "trailer <title>".
remote_guide_cmd1: Send "/download <url> [format]" → downloads right away. Formats: 1080p, 720p, mp3, mkv (e.g. /download https://... 1080p). Leave the format out to pick from a menu instead.
remote_guide_cmd2: Send "/torrent <title>" → searches for a torrent: reply with a number to download it, or write "more" for the next results.
remote_guide_cmd3: Send "/trailer <title>" → searches for the trailer on YouTube.
remote_guide_cmd4: Paste a magnet: link → downloads it right away.
remote_guide_cmd5: Share a Shazam link (shazam.com/track/...) → searches for the torrent of the recognised track.
remote_guide_cmd6: If you've enabled send-to-client (below, in Integrations → Send to client), torrents picked from here go straight there instead of just saving the file.
remote_guide_cmd7: Send "/login <code>" → pairs a new phone with FLUX (send it from the phone you want to add, using the code generated above).
remote_guide_cmd8: Send "/help" → shows this command list again, any time.
remote_guide_cmd9: You don’t need the commands — plain text still works: paste a URL, type a title, or write "trailer <title>".
remote_guide_note: The token is like a password — don't share it. Only chats paired with the code can command FLUX.
